t: You're looking at St Paul's Church in Covent Garden, a Church of England parish church on Bedford Street. Inigo Jones designed it, as part of a commission from the 4th Earl of Bedford in 1631 for houses fit for gentlemen and men of ability. It began as an auxiliary chapel of the St Martin-in-the-Fields parish, and became a parish church dedicated to Saint Paul in 1646. Today it's nicknamed the actors' church, thanks to its long link with the theatre community. Buried here are Ellen Terry, Edith Evans, Michael Redgrave and Peter O'Toole.
